result_status.description: Common status of a result, whatever tool produced it. It records what the sources allowed to be said, never a judgement of the researcher or the output.

terms.definition: The sources answered and the result is reported with its evidence.
terms.may_be_read_as: A result, within the coverage of the sources consulted.

terms.definition: The sources answered and contain nothing relevant.
terms.may_be_read_as: Not found in these sources. Never proof that the practice or contribution does not exist.

terms.definition: A source failed or there was nothing to count, so the result cannot be established.
No infrastructure can document this; only the person or a human assessor can.
The check does not apply to this case (for example random seeds in code without randomness).
terms.may_be_read_as: Neither a strength nor a gap.

evidence_level.description: Strength of the evidence behind an integrity-related finding. Levels are not interchangeable: a lower level is never reported with the wording of a higher one.

terms.definition: A statistical or computational indicator departs from what is expected for comparable cases.
terms.may_be_read_as: Worth a closer look. Has many innocent explanations; not evidence of misconduct.

terms.definition: Several independent signals recur across records, time or actors.
terms.may_be_read_as: A pattern that needs documentary verification and alternative explanations.

terms.definition: Primary documents (publisher notices, data files, correspondence, images) support the finding.
An independent, competent body has reached a finding (retraction with stated cause, institutional or judicial decision).
terms.may_be_read_as: Established by the cited body; cite it, do not restate it as the tool's own conclusion.

ai_use_basis.description: How a statement about AI use in research is known.

terms.definition: Stated by the authors or the research team (disclosure, log, statement).
terms.may_be_read_as: What the authors say they did.

terms.definition: Estimated by a tool or analyst from indirect features of the text or process.
terms.may_be_read_as: A probabilistic estimate. Automated AI-text detection is not proof of AI authorship.

terms.definition: Confirmed by direct evidence such as a contemporaneous log checked by a person.
